# Modal

## Summary
A layered dialog rendered on a native `<dialog>` element.

## Shape
`@isOpen`, `@onClose` and `@size` (`x-small` through `full-screen`) are the contract, with the
body yielded so a consumer composes content without touching the overlay. Building on
`HTMLDialogElement` means focus containment and top-layer stacking come from the platform
rather than from hand-rolled listeners. `@isOverlayDismissalDisabled` turns off click-outside
closing for a dialog that must be answered, and `@layer: 'urgent'` raises one modal above
another. `@centered`, `@backgroundImageURL` and `@boxelModalOverlayColor` adjust presentation.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/modal/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { Modal } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
